title: Measures to Rehabilitate and Protect At-risk Individuals and Offenders
what_it_is: Measures to Rehabilitate and Protect At-risk Individuals and Offenders

sections.label: Youth GO! and Enhanced STEP-UP
sections.summary: Youth GO! workers reach about 300 youths monthly, and the Enhanced STEP-UP programme benefits over 600 youths yearly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Youth GO! workers reach out to around 300 youths each month and engage them in structured activities, which reduces risky behaviours and improves their relationships and lifeskills.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: MSF works closely with the Ministry of Education to provide the Enhanced STEP-UP (ESU) programme, benefiting more than 600 youths each year.

sections.label: ISP programmes and youth arrests
sections.summary: ISPs have worked with around 900 youths and families, and arrests of youths aged seven to 19 fell 13% from 2014 to 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: ISPs run programmes to address offending behaviours and have worked with around 900 youths and families so far.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: On average, more than 80% of the youths satisfactorily complete their programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Arrests of youths aged between seven and 19 years old have fallen from around 3,100 in 2014 to 2,700 in 2018, a decrease of 13%.

sections.label: Recidivism rate improvement
sections.summary: Recidivism improved from 19.5% for cases closed 2007 to 2009 to 12.5% for cases closed 2010 to 2014.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: A 19.5% recidivism rate for cases closed from 2007 to 2009 improved to 12.5% for cases closed from 2010 to 2014.

sections.label: Extended post-care support in Youth Homes
sections.summary: Post-care support in Youth Homes is being extended from two months to one year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Fourth, we sustain rehabilitative outcomes to better reintegrate children with their families and society.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We announced during the Committee of Supply this year that we are extending the period of post-care support in Youth Homes from two months to one year.

sections.label: Protecting youth offenders' identity
sections.summary: Recent amendments to the Children and Young Persons Act include enhancing protection of youth offenders' identity and privacy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: In addition, labelling someone as an ex-offender makes reintegration more difficult for him or her.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Hence, our recent amendments to the Children and Young Persons Act have also included enhancing the protection of youth offenders' identity and privacy.
